class.name: LANLobbyDirectory
class.brief_description: Finds ENet games on the local network without typing an address.
class.description: A host is listed while its session is the server of an [ENetMultiplayerPeer] and its [NetwServerInfo] is [constant NetwServerInfo.VISIBILITY_PUBLIC]. Each host answers with its own gameplay port, so a listed game is joined with nothing else. Discovery uses UDP broadcast, so it does nothing on web and reaches one network interface.

members.member: The first discovery port. Hosts on one machine take the next free one.
How many ports from [member port] a host may take and a browser asks.
